outcome: number and composition of CD4+ cells in umbilical cord
number and morphology of CD4+ cells in umbilical cord
CD8+ cell distribution in umbilical cord
number and morphology of CD14+ cells in umbilical cord
presence of CD19+ cells in umbilical cord
presence of CD21+ cells in umbilical cord
number and morphology of CD56+ cells in umbilical cord
cohort: Umbilical cords were obtained from seven women with autoimmune disorders, eight with autoimmune disorders and MTHFR polymorphisms, nine with MTHFR polymorphisms, and eight with neither.
finding: Maternal risk factors, such as autoimmune disorders and/or MTHFR polymorphisms, significantly affect the number, composition, distribution, and morphology of various immune cells (CD4+, CD8+, CD14+, CD19+, CD21+, CD56+) within different zones of the umbilical cord.
